#include<bits/stdc++.h>

int bs(std::vector& vec, int obj) {
int ans = -1;
auto it = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), obj);
if(it != vec.end() && *it == obj) {
ans = (it - vec.begin()) + 1;
return ans;
}
return ans;
}

void solve() {
int m, n;
int tmp;
std::cin >> m >> n;
std::vector v(m);
for(int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
std::cin >> v[i];
}
for(int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
std::cin >> tmp;
std::cout << bs(v, tmp) << ' ';
}
}

int main() {
std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
std::cin.tie(0);
solve();
return 0;
}

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define ll long long

ll sum(std::vector &v, int h) {
ll s = 0;
auto it = std::lower_bound(v.begin(), v.end(), h);
for(;it != v.end(); ++it) {
s += (*it - h);
}
return s;
}

int bs(std::vector &v, int obj) {
int mx = 0;
for(auto it = v.begin(); it != v.end(); ++it) {
mx = std::max(*it, mx);
}
int ans = 0;
int lt = 0, rt = mx;
while(lt <= rt) {
int mid = lt + (rt - lt) / 2;
if (sum(v, mid) == obj) {
return mid;
}
else if(sum(v, mid) > obj) {
ans = mid;
lt = mid + 1;
}
else rt = mid - 1;
}
return ans;
}

void solve() {
int m, n;

std::cin >> m >> n;
std::vector<

int> vec(m);
for(int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
std::cin >> vec[i];
}
std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());
int ans = bs(vec, n);
std::cout << ans <<'\n';
}

int main() {
std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
std::cin.tie(0);
solve();
return 0;
}
